description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Role Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking an experienced Security Engineer – AI Expert to evaluate the quality, accuracy, and completeness of vulnerability reproduction and remediation tasks used to train and assess advanced AI models.
 In this role, you will review security engineering tasks to determine whether CVE reproductions accurately reflect real-world vulnerabilities, remediation strategies effectively address identified security flaws, and verification procedures reliably validate both functionality and security. You will also assess Docker-based lab environments to ensure they faithfully recreate exploitable conditions and support consistent testing.
 The ideal candidate has strong practical experience in application security, penetration testing, or vulnerability research, along with expertise in secure coding, vulnerability analysis, and containerized testing environments.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Evaluate vulnerability reproduction tasks for technical accuracy, completeness, and fidelity to documented CVEs.
 Assess remediation approaches to ensure security fixes address root causes without introducing regressions or new vulnerabilities.
 Review vulnerability classifications and severity assessments using frameworks such as CVSS, CWE, and CAPEC.
 Validate security testing logic, including both functionality tests and vulnerability-specific verification tests.
 Assess Docker and Docker Compose environments for accurate vulnerability reproduction, exploitability, and reproducibility.
 Review implementations covering common vulnerability classes, including SQL injection, command injection, buffer overflows, insecure deserialization, SSRF, security misconfigurations, and privilege escalation.
 Identify gaps in exploit reproduction steps, remediation quality, test coverage, and environment configuration.
 Provide clear, actionable, rubric-based written feedback to improve the quality and reliability of security-focused AI evaluation tasks.
 Basic Qualifications
 3+ years of hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing, or vulnerability research.
 Strong understanding of CVE vulnerability taxonomy and severity frameworks, including CVSS, CWE, and CAPEC.
 Demonstrated expertise in secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation across common security vulnerability classes, such as:
 SQL injection and command injection.
 Buffer overflows and memory-safety issues.
 Insecure deserialization.
 Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
 Security misconfigurations.
 Privilege escalation.
 Experience designing or evaluating two-part verification logic involving functionality tests and vulnerability tests.
 Proficiency with Docker and Docker Compose for building and managing multi-container vulnerability reproduction environments.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Relevant offensive-security certifications, such as OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or equivalent.
 Experience with CVE disclosure processes, responsible vulnerability reporting, or maintaining exploit proof-of-concept code.
 Background in DevSecOps, CI/CD security gating, or Static and Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
 Previous experience in technical content review, assessment design, or quality assurance for security-focused engineering tasks.
 Contract and Payment Terms
 Engagement as an independent contractor.
 Fully remote role with a flexible schedule.
 Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on project requirements and performance.
 Work will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Payments are made weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 H-1B and STEM OPT candidates cannot be supported at this time.
